arrival_process.conditional_independence: device counts are independent Poisson draws conditional on the shared state
arrival_process.state_scope: one shared aggregate state per tick

bursty_heterogeneous_demand.budget_policy: reuse the primary homogeneous experiment's pressure-20 vector frozen from disjoint pilot seeds; no robustness-arm recalibration
bursty_heterogeneous_demand.estimand: pool overspend percent in dimensionless score-unit accounting

accounting.debit_rule: round the auction's floating score output once to the nearest integer, with half values rounded away from zero by Rust f64::round
accounting.legacy_internal_identifiers: the shared simulator retains *_cents Rust field names for compatibility with earlier deposited rows; this artifact's public schema uses score-unit names
accounting.transfer_scope: overspend mechanisms are evaluated only at this chosen score granularity; guard and small-lag rounding results are not claimed to transfer to a currency ledger

protocol.budget_derivation: same frozen mean unconstrained vertical score-unit debit from primary pilot rows, divided by campaigns in vertical and pressure target, rounded per campaign, then frozen before evaluation
protocol.device_assignment: each tick, each device independently draws Poisson(arrivals_per_tick / n_devices) arrivals; every arrival independently samples one context uniformly
